svg.text: Layout A · large title above the chips; on collapse the title and buttons pin and the chips scroll away
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915, synthetic data only. Frames: 1 expanded top (PRs), 2 mid-collapse, 3 fully collapsed, 4 Issues, 5 Activity, 6 search open.
6 · Search open from the collapsed bar
Expanded at top: large title over the chips, sync line and MINE rows.
Mid-collapse: title shrinking; next, the chips scroll away with the list
Fully collapsed: title small, buttons stay; chips scrolled away (A).
Unit status filter ignores closed communities
Rotate agent token on service restart
Issues tab expanded: status pill rows sit under the chip row.
Activity tab expanded: filter chips, filter line, grouped update rows.
Search open from the collapsed bar: input replaces the icon buttons.

Setup: the same in every frame, phone only at 412x915 (Android, status bar at top, bottom tab bar PRs / Issues / Activity with badges). Below the header the app keeps its filter chip row, its “Synced 10s ago · API 4,909 left” line, section headers
such as MINE 4 and the rows. Issues #32, #33 and #39 change those later; this round only fixes where they sit relative to the header in each state.

Layout A: the large title sits above the chip row. On collapse the title and the search/menu buttons pin as a compact bar and the chips scroll away with the content. Layout B: on collapse only the title shrinks, and the chip row stays pinned as the
sticky filter strip under the compact bar. Search opens from the collapsed bar and replaces the bar in both layouts; in B the strip stays pinned under the search row.

Sample data only: repos acme-co/orders-api and acme-dev/tools; authors acme-dev, build-bot and sam-lee. All labels are synthetic. This is round 1: greyscale labelled boxes, minimum 12px text, no colour or styling.
